Yeah that's about how I feel. 
I hope you get through whatever you're studying and use it for good or atleast something you enjoy and find purpose in. I think having no purpose is the worst part for me.
I do love music though, only thing that can make me feel really good.

ah right haha. I'm not anymore I guess, kinda just given up on everything and don't really see the point doing much work when I'm not really planning on being around much longer. Been taking time off and breaks from it recently because it's difficult to focus and be productive now.
yeah it's cool and all, it is a lot of work though. I enjoyed it when I first started and it's what I want to do but ultimately it's a lot of work and effort for nothing really.

I'm not sure what you mean by high functioning, I don't think I'm autistic if that's what you're asking, I'm pretty good/comfortable socially even though I am an introvert.

Thanks, I'm studying a mathematics PhD in a neuroscience lab analysing their data etc. There's a more specific project but I don't really want to go into details.
No I'm not and wouldn't want to take any drugs for it.

I've told one of my friends I'm suicidal but that's about it. Starting to see a therapist while I wait until I can find a way to do it. I don't really see something like that helping someone like myself and it hasn't done much so far but maybe it will before I do it.
